items.title: Unix composition requires opt-in unix-ipc feature for UDS serving
items.detail: Default unix build keeps the honest scaffold message; `--features unix-ipc` compiles the real UDS transport. Packaging must ship the service built with unix-ipc on macOS/Linux.

items.title: macOS sun_path constraint shapes the rendezvous path
items.detail: sun_path is 104 bytes; per-user $TMPDIR can exceed it. default_socket_dir anchors at ${AETHERCORE_IPC_ROOT:-/tmp}/aethercore-ipc/v7 and tests use short /tmp roots.

items.title: Accepted sockets inherit listener non-blocking mode on macOS
items.detail: A poll-style accept window makes the stop flag responsive, but accepted streams inherit non-blocking mode, which races session reads. accept() now forces the stream back to blocking before returning.
items.disposition: fixed in crates/ipc/src/unix_impl.rs::accept; covered by GD integration test

items.title: Update coordinator cannot resolve the OS build off-Windows
items.detail: composition passes current_windows_build_or_zero(); update eligibility stays disabled off-Windows exactly as the honest matrix reports windowsUpdate NotAvailable.
